page.title: Mods
page.about: Mods draw Yuzora's panels; layouts arrange them. The shipped ones come with Yuzora and are put back on every start: clone one to change it.

about_mods: Folders in mods/ of Yuzora's home. Errors come from the window's status.
about_layouts: Files in layouts/. Each keeps its own look; switch any time. The Yuzora dock holds the Files, Git, Database and SSH modes on the right: Auto uses the layout's panel, or a drawer where it has none; your choice here beats the layout file's own.
reset_kept: Put back as shipped; your edits are in {name}.
layout_reset: Reset; the old file was kept aside.
edited_about: This shipped mod was edited in place. The next start moves the edits to {name}-edited and puts the shipped one back; Reset does it now.
edited_later: This shipped mod was edited in place. The next start moves the edits to {name}-edited and puts the shipped one back.
trust_about: A mod runs with the same rights as Yuzora: it can run programs, reach the network and read and write your files. Install only what you trust, and read it first.
install_keys: It comes with a keys.json: add its keys to yours by hand (or ask your agent).
installed: Installed. New mods load on their own.

install_errors.stale: That plan is out of date: pick the folder again.
install_errors.not_a_mod: That folder has no main.js, and no mods/ or layouts/ folder.
install_errors.inside_home: That folder is already in Yuzora's home.
install_errors.too_big: That folder is too big to be a mod (over 2000 files or 64 MB).
